name: PA-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Scanlon with large fundraising edge
model.rationale: Scanlon holds a D+15 district with a roughly hundredfold fundraising advantage and no outside spending against her, while Polymarket prices her near certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings to the contrary, the fundamentals-based margin of about 23 points stands.
model.watch: A late surge of outside Republican spending or an unexpectedly strong challenger campaign would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Incumbent Mary Gay Scanlon (D) is running.

overview:
Mary Gay Scanlon seeks another term in a Delaware County seat that leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 15 points. She enters the general election with a renomination secured, roughly $990,000 raised and $449,000 on hand, and no outside groups opposing her.

Republican Nicholas Manganaro has raised under $10,000 with about $6,000 cash, leaving him little capacity to compete, and no outside spending has materialized on his behalf. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 98 percent. The fundamentals point to a comfortable incumbent victory.
